name: clashhq
description: Self-hosted Clash of Clans clan management app — Phase 0 tooling

notes.phase0-scope: Phase 0 installs only the tooling needed for the capability registry, Zod validation, and sanitizer tests. Fastify, better-sqlite3, Drizzle ORM, React, Vite, ESLint, Prettier, and Playwright are Phase 1 and later.
notes.better-sqlite3: Pre-built binary check for Node 24 on Windows/macOS/Linux to be verified in Phase 1 before locking the dependency (spec §3).
notes.node-pin: Node 24 LTS pinned in .nvmrc, engines field, Dockerfile (Phase 1), and CI (Phase 1). Do not target EOL Node releases.
